# awscc_medialive_input_security_group (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaLive::InputSecurityGroup



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) A collection of key-value pairs.
- `whitelist_rules` (Attributes List) Whitelist rules and their sync status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whitelist_rules))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Unique ARN of Input Security Group
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `input_security_group_id` (String) The Id of the Input Security Group
- `inputs` (List of String) The list of inputs currently using this Input Security Group.

<a id="nestedatt--whitelist_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `whitelist_rules`

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) The IPv4 CIDR that's whitelisted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_medialive_input_security_group.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```
